description: This file contains Python code for parsing JSON data related to web configuration support, including functions for processing subdocuments, managing bit positions, and generating output files based on device-specific data.

methods.name: supported_docs
methods.description: Processes individual subdocuments, updating global state based on their properties.

methods.name: supplementary_docs
methods.description: Adds a document name to the list of supplementary documents.

methods.name: supported_versions
methods.description: Records supported version ranges for documents.

methods.name: bit_position
methods.description: Populates the bit position map with details about each subdocument.

methods.name: decimal_converter
methods.description: Converts bit positions to version values and updates supported bits.

methods.name: bit_calc
methods.description: Calculates binary values for bit positions and updates global group bits.

methods.name: append_bit
methods.description: Appends group ID nibble to version bits.

methods.name: local_main
methods.description: Loads JSON data from source file and initiates parsing.

methods.name: json_read
methods.description: Parses JSON data for a specific device, updates global state, and writes output file.
